title: An Analysis of Spatial Homicide Patterns in Chicago
description: Explored the spatial and socioeconomic drivers behind Chicago's homicide patterns, analyzing 8.4 million crime records to pinpoint where the city's violence was actually concentrated.

title: Hidden NAFSI Predictive Modeling for Agricultural Resilience
description: Developed a probabilistic vegetation model utilizing Hilbert Space Gaussian Processes in NumPyro and JAX to predict seasonal crop growth trajectories for corn, soybean, and winter wheat across the U.S. Corn Belt. 1st place recognition among all competing teams in the inaugural 2026 NAFSI Student Data Challenge, earning the $2,000 top prize.

title: Probabilistic Modeling of True Hitting Talent in Major League Baseball
description: Built an MLB home run projection system to estimate underlying hitting talent from a player's batted-ball profile rather than relying solely on noisy home run counts.

title: Hidden Unshifting the Infield: Spatial Out-Probabilities in the Post-Shift Era
description: Leveraged Bayesian ensemble trees in PyMC to model infield out-probabilities (0.86 held-out ROC-AUC), mapping the spatial impact of the 2023 MLB shift ban.

title: Hidden A Bayesian Approach to Modeling Arm-Injury Risk in Pitchers
description: Developed a Bayesian hierarchical model in PyMC to forecast the latent arm-injury risk and burden for # MLB pitchers. Created an interactive dashboard to visualize player uncertainty estimates.

title: Sean McVAI: Beating Two-High Coverage
description: Evaluated NFL offensive play designs against two-high coverage, estimating the expected yardage associated with different ways of attacking the defensive alignment.

title: Bayesball in the Outfield: Quantifying Defensive Aggression With a Bayesian Hierarchical Model
description: Developed an Aggression Over Expected metric to quantify how aggressively outfielders approach balls in play while accounting for differences in position and opportunity.

title: The Effect of Two Strikes on a Hitter's Swing
description: Analyzed how MLB hitters adjust their swing mechanics in two-strike counts, using Statcast data to visualize changes in approach and contact.

title: Hidden What Is a Home Worth? Large-Scale Ensemble Learning for U.S. Housing Prices
description: Architected a predictive pricing pipeline for 2.2M+ U.S. properties, synthesizing heterogeneous data sources (crime, tax, demographics) into a gradient-boosting framework to capture complex market drivers.

title: Hidden Spotify Popularity Analysis
description: A statistical analysis on 100,000+ Spotify tracks to identify key audio features linked to song popularity.

title: Hidden Power Outages Statistical Analysis
description: Developed a Random Forest regressor to forecast regional energy consumption, utilizing permutation tests and NMAR analysis to quantify statistical dependencies between electricity sales and peak demand loss.

title: Hidden PSCL Interactive Dashboard
description: The interactive Looker Studio dashboard that provides a user-friendly interface for coaches and players to track their performances and showcase their abilities to college scouts for the PSCL.
